gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-010 identifies the same failed row-space invariance identity F^T D^{-1}=F^T D^{-1}P_F, explains that D^{-1} need not preserve range(F), and gives an explicit admissible counterexample. It also connects this defect to the unsupported real-spectrum and RW-Fair-SMW top-eigenvector claims, with a repair requiring a valid spectral argument or a corrected formulation.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proof incorrectly assumes that right multiplication by the projection P_F leaves the relevant row space invariant, equivalently that D^{-1}range(F) lies in range(F). This invalidates the simplification used to obtain the claimed symmetric/similar representation of U_rw and therefore the unconditional real-spectrum and always-real top-k conclusions.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed identity involving F^T D^{-1} and P_F is not generally valid because D^{-1} does not preserve the row space/range of F; consequently the RW operator need not have the claimed real spectrum or support an unconditional real top-k embedding.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction directly diagnoses the invalid row-space preservation step, supplies a concrete counterexample, and identifies the resulting failure of the real-eigenvalue guarantee and top-eigenvector construction, while proposing a mathematically targeted repair.
